title: CSS & Mobile UI Improvements
description: Epic covering CSS consolidation, mobile gesture system optimization, and UI performance improvements. Key areas: 19 CSS files to consolidate, layout thrashing fixes, !important cleanup, mobile gesture simplification.

title: Consolidate 19 CSS files into bundled modules
description: Currently 19 separate CSS files causing: 1) Multiple parse/compile/apply cycles, 2) Cascading style recalculations, 3) ~100-200ms additional load time. Proposed structure: base.css (foundation), components.css (merged from buttons, forms, notifications), layout.css (keep but split desktop/mobile), graph.css (merge graph-controls, edge-list, results-panel), branding.css (keep).

title: Fix layout thrashing in canvas-gesture.js
description: getBoundingClientRect() called 6+ times per touch event causing 5-10ms per touch event. Found in canvas-gesture.js - called on EVERY touch event without caching. Fix: Cache rect at touchstart, reuse for touchmove/touchend. Also cache window dimensions.

title: Remove excessive !important declarations in layout.css
description: Excessive !important usage in mobile gesture feedback (lines 322-350 of layout.css). This creates specificity wars and makes CSS harder to maintain. Audit all !important uses, refactor selectors to use proper specificity instead.

title: Simplify mobile gesture system
description: canvas-gesture.js is 1,184 lines - over-engineered for basic mobile interactions. Consider: 1) Replace with CSS scroll-snap for simple gestures, 2) Use Hammer.js library for complex gestures, 3) At minimum, extract velocity calculations to separate module. Current system has complex z-index management and velocity physics that may not be necessary.

title: Remove backup/temp CSS files
description: Remove unused files: layout.css.backup and layout_temp.css. These are cluttering the codebase and could cause confusion.

title: Add RAF throttling to high-frequency event handlers
description: Mouse move handlers fire at 100+ Hz, touch move handlers process every micro-movement. Add requestAnimationFrame throttling to: 1) Touch/mouse move handlers in canvas-gesture.js, 2) Resize handlers, 3) Any scroll listeners. This will cap updates at 60fps and reduce CPU usage.

title: Cache getComputedStyle calls in gesture detection
description: Multiple getComputedStyle calls in euler-toggles.js and gesture detection code. Each call forces style recalculation. Cache results during gesture sequences: position, zIndex, display values should be read once and reused.

title: Split layout.css into desktop and mobile modules
description: layout.css is 758 lines handling both desktop (≥769px) and mobile (≤768px) layouts. Split into: layout-base.css (shared), layout-desktop.css (desktop-specific), layout-mobile.css (mobile-specific). Use media query imports or CSS @layer for organization.

title: Merge small CSS files into logical groups
description: Several CSS files are too small to justify separate files: loading.css (40 lines) -> merge into components.css, custom-icons.css -> merge into components.css, euler-toggles.css -> merge into components.css. This reduces HTTP requests and parse overhead.
